questions.question: What was the name of the operation launched in May 2025 in response to a terror attack in Pahalgam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Sindoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Sindoor** was a major counter-terrorism initiative launched in **May 2025** in response to a sudden terror attack in the **Pahalgam** region of **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• The operation was conducted as a joint tactical exercise involving the **Indian Army**, the **Special Operations Group (SOG)** of the state police, and the **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)** to neutralize high-value targets.
 
• The primary objective of **Operation Sindoor** was to secure the **Lidder Valley** and clear the surrounding forest areas of **Anantnag** district from infiltrating militants who posed a threat to local peace.
 
• Security forces utilized **cutting-edge technology**, including **thermal imaging drones** and **night-vision equipment**, to track movements across the difficult mountainous terrain of **Pahalgam**.
 
• This operation was crucial for maintaining the safety of the **Amarnath Yatra** pilgrimage route, which passes through **Pahalgam** and attracts thousands of devotees annually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographical Context of Pahalgam**:
 
 
• **Pahalgam** is a world-famous hill station located in the **Anantnag** district of **Jammu and Kashmir** at an altitude of approximately **2,740 meters**.
 
• It serves as the starting point for the traditional route of the **Amarnath Yatra** and is located at the confluence of the streams flowing from **Sheshnag Lake** and the **Lidder River**.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Military Operations**:
 
 
• **Operation Vijay**: This was the successful mission conducted by the **Indian Armed Forces** in **1999** to recapture the heights in the **Kargil** sector from Pakistani infiltrators.
 
• **Operation All-Out**: A multi-agency strategy launched in **2017** to flush out militants from various districts of **Kashmir**, aimed at restoring long-term stability.
 
• **Operation Sadbhavana**: Also known as **Operation Goodwill**, this is an initiative by the **Indian Army** in **Jammu and Kashmir** to address the needs of the local population through education, infrastructure, and healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Significance**:
 
 
• The security grid in **Jammu and Kashmir** is continuously monitored by the **Unified Command**, which ensures coordination between the **Army**, **Paramilitary forces**, and **Intelligence agencies**.
 
• Following the **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019**, there has been an increased focus on intelligence-led operations to prevent **cross-border infiltration**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The success of **Operation Sindoor** in **2025** demonstrated the enhanced **Electronic Intelligence (ELINT)** capabilities of the **Indian Army** in high-altitude combat.
 
• The timing of the operation in **May** was critical as it coincided with the preparation phase for the **summer tourism season**, which is the backbone of the local economy in **Pahalgam**.
 
• The **Rashtriya Rifles (RR)**, the specialized counter-insurgency force of the **Indian Army**, played a leading role in the ground-level execution of the operation.
</ul

questions.question: Which Union Minister unveiled a new logo of Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) in October 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotiraditya M Scindia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union Minister **Jyotiraditya M Scindia** unveiled the new logo of **Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL)** on **October 22, 2024**, in **New Delhi**.
 
• The new logo, featuring the vibrant colors of the **Indian National Flag** (Saffron, White, and Green), signifies **BSNL's** renewed commitment to connecting every corner of the **country** with trust and strength.
 
• Alongside the logo, the Minister introduced **seven new citizen-centric services** designed to make **BSNL** a more competitive and consumer-friendly telecom provider.
 
• The launch event highlighted **BSNL's** transition from a recovery phase to a growth phase, focusing on **high-speed internet** and **secure communication** for the **common man**.
 
• The Minister emphasized that the new identity reflects the vision of an **"Atmanirbhar Bharat"** (Self-reliant India) in the telecommunications sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BSNL (Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited)**: It is a **Central Public Sector Undertaking** headquartered in **New Delhi**, incorporated on **October 1, 2000**. It provides a wide range of telecom services across **India**, except in Delhi and Mumbai (served by MTNL).
 
• **Ministerial Portfolios**: **Jyotiraditya M Scindia** currently serves as the **Union Minister of Communications** and the **Minister of Rural Development**. He took charge of these portfolios in **June 2024**.
 
• **Other Options**:
 
 
• **Amit Shah** serves as the **Union Minister of Home Affairs** and the first **Minister of Cooperation**.
 
• **Giriraj Singh** holds the portfolio of the **Union Minister of Textiles**.
 
• **Jitin Prasada** is the **Minister of State** in the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** and the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology**.
 
 
 
• **Technological Shift**: **BSNL** is working on deploying a **4G network** using **indigenous technology** developed by a consortium led by **TCS**, **C-DOT**, and **Tejas Networks**, which is designed to be seamlessly upgradable to **5G**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Seven New Services**: The services launched include a **Spam-free network** (using **AI** to block malicious SMS), **National Wi-Fi Roaming** for FTTH users, and **BSNL IFTTV** (Internet Fiber TV).
 
• **Direct-to-Cell Technology**: This service was introduced to provide connectivity in remote areas by bypassing traditional mobile towers and connecting devices directly via **satellite**.
 
• **Any-time SIM (ATM)**: **BSNL** launched automated kiosks that allow users to buy, replace, or port **SIM cards** 24/7 using **QR-enabled** payments and **KYC** integration.
 
• **Public Protection & Disaster Relief (PPDR)**: A specialized communication solution designed for **emergency services** and **disaster management** agencies to ensure uninterrupted connectivity during crises.
</ul

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the large-scale civil defence mock drill named Operation Shield conducted on May 2025?

options.text: To test the effectiveness of coastal security protocols
To improve the state's emergency readiness and response systems
To enhance readiness against internal insurgencies
To simulate response to natural disasters in Himalayan regions

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To improve the state's emergency readiness and response systems**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Shield** is a large-scale **civil defence mock drill** designed to evaluate the **preparedness and efficacy** of state administrative and emergency services.
 
• Conducted in **May 2025**, the exercise aims to refine the **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)** followed by various departments during high-stress **crisis situations**.
 
• The primary objective of this operation is to **improve the state's emergency readiness and response systems** by testing the **inter-departmental coordination** between the **Police**, **Fire Department**, **Health Services**, and **Disaster Management** units. ***Hence, the correct answer is option 2.***
 
• During the drill, personnel practice **rapid deployment** and **rescue operations** in simulated environments to identify **operational bottlenecks** and improve the **reaction time** of first responders.
 
• The initiative also focuses on the **training of civil defence volunteers**, ensuring that **local communities** have a structured **first-aid** and **evacuation** support system during real-time disasters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Civil Defence in India**: 
 
 
• Civil Defence is primarily governed by the **Civil Defence Act, 1968**, which was enacted to protect persons and property against **hostile attacks**.
 
• In recent years, its scope has expanded to include **disaster management** and **community resilience** during natural and man-made calamities.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)**:
 
 
• The **NDMA** is the **apex statutory body** for disaster management in India, headed by the **Prime Minister**.
 
• It was established under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, and is responsible for framing **national policies** and **guidelines** for disaster mitigation.
 
 
 
• **Mock Drills and Simulations**:
 
 
• **Mock drills** are essential tools used by **state and central agencies** to simulate **hazardous events** like **earthquakes**, **chemical leaks**, or **terrorist threats**.
 
• These exercises help in verifying the **functionality of emergency equipment** and the **clarity of communication channels** used by the **rescue teams**.
 
 
 
• **State Disaster Response Force (SDRF)**:
 
 
• Modeled after the **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)**, the **SDRF** is the specialized force at the **state level** dedicated to responding to **disaster situations**.
 
• It plays a vital role in **Operation Shield** by providing the **technical expertise** needed for specialized **search and rescue** tasks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Operation Shield**: Such drills are crucial for **urban planning** and **public safety**, especially in densely populated **industrial hubs** or **vulnerable geographical zones**.
 
• **Community Involvement**: A major component of these drills is **public awareness**, teaching citizens how to use **emergency helplines** and basic **survival techniques**.
 
• **Technological Integration**: In **2025**, these drills often incorporate **advanced technology** such as **drones for aerial surveillance**, **AI-based casualty estimation**, and **real-time tracking** of emergency vehicles.
</ul

questions.question: Who among the following authored the 2025 book “Rocket Dreams: Musk, Bezos, and the Inside Story of the New, Trillion-Dollar Space Race”, which explores the fierce rivalries among billionaires in the modern space race?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Christian Davenport**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **“Rocket Dreams: Musk, Bezos, and the Inside Story of the New, Trillion-Dollar Space Race”** is authored by **Christian Davenport**, a prominent journalist and author specialized in the space industry.
 
• Published in early **2025**, the book serves as a sequel or an extensive follow-up to his previous reporting on the evolution of private space flight and the commercialization of the **cosmos**.
 
• The narrative explores the intense **rivalry** between billionaires **Elon Musk**, the founder of **SpaceX**, and **Jeff Bezos**, the founder of **Blue Origin**, detailing their personal and professional clashes.
 
• It examines the shift from government-led exploration to a **trillion-dollar space economy**, highlighting the role of private capital in missions to **Low Earth Orbit (LEO)** and the **Moon**.
 
• The book provides inside accounts of the **technological breakthroughs**, political lobbying, and the ambitious goal of making humanity a **multi-planetary species**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Christian Davenport**: He is a veteran reporter for **The Washington Post**, where he covers the **defense and space industries**. He is also the author of the **2018** bestseller **"The Space Barons,"** which first chronicled the rise of private space ventures.
 
• **Walter Isaacson**: A renowned biographer who published the comprehensive biography **"Elon Musk"** in **September 2023**. While his work covers **SpaceX** extensively, he is not the author of "Rocket Dreams."
 
• **Ashlee Vance**: An American business columnist and author known for writing **"Elon Musk: Tesla, SpaceX, and the Quest for a Fantastic Future"** in **2015**, which was one of the first major biographies of Musk.
 
• **Neil deGrasse Tyson**: A world-famous **astrophysicist** and director of the **Hayden Planetarium**. He has authored several books on science, such as **"Astrophysics for People in a Hurry"** and **"Starry Messenger,"** but his work focuses on science communication rather than the business history of the space race.
 
• **The New Space Race**: Unlike the **Cold War** era race between the **United States** and the **Soviet Union**, the modern space race is characterized by **reusable rocket technology**, satellite mega-constellations like **Starlink**, and competition for **NASA** contracts under the **Artemis program**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **trillion-dollar** valuation mentioned in the title refers to projections by financial institutions like **Morgan Stanley** and **Goldman Sachs**, suggesting the space industry will exceed **$1 trillion** in annual revenue by **2040**.
 
• Major milestones covered in recent space literature include the success of the **Falcon 9** rockets, the development of the **Starship** spacecraft, and the **New Shepard** suborbital missions.
 
• The competition between **Musk** and **Bezos** has legal dimensions, including disputes over **launch pads** at **Kennedy Space Center** and **NASA lunar lander** contracts.

questions.question: What is the name of India’s first AI-generated school teacher robot, unveiled by Makerlabs Edutech at a school in Kerala?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Iris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iris** is India’s first **AI-generated school teacher robot**, representing a significant milestone in the integration of **Artificial Intelligence** within the education sector.
 
• The robot was developed by **Makerlabs Edutech** and was officially unveiled at **KTCT Higher Secondary School** in **Thiruvananthapuram**, **Kerala**, in **March 2024**.
 
• It was created as part of the **Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL)** project, an initiative by **NITI Aayog** designed to foster curiosity and innovation among school students across **India**.
 
• **Iris** is a **humanoid** robot capable of speaking **three languages** and is designed to answer a wide range of complex questions, providing a personalized interactive learning experience for students.
 
• Equipped with a **voice assistant** and interactive capabilities, the robot can move on **wheels**, gesture with its hands, and engage students in a manner that supplements traditional teaching methods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Makerlabs Edutech:**
 
 
• It is a **Kochi-based** startup specializing in **Educational Technology**, **Robotics**, and **AI** solutions.
 
• The development of **Iris** highlights the growing **startup ecosystem** in **Kerala**, often supported by the **Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM)**.
 
 
 
• **Technical Features of Iris:**
 
 
• The robot is built using a high-performance **Intel processor** and a dedicated **coprocessor** to handle real-time interactions.
 
• It utilizes **Generative AI** technologies (similar to **ChatGPT**) to process information and generate human-like responses to academic queries.
 
• To make the robot more relatable to students in **Kerala**, it is designed as a **humanoid** figure dressed in traditional **Saree** attire.
 
 
 
• **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM):**
 
 
• Launched by **NITI Aayog**, **AIM** is the **Government of India’s** flagship initiative to promote a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship.
 
• The **Atal Tinkering Labs** are established in schools to provide students with hands-on experience in **STEM** (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) fields.
 
 
 
• **Comparative Context:**
 
 
• While **Iris** is a pioneer in Indian classrooms, other famous robots include **Sophia**, developed by **Hanson Robotics**, which became the first robot to receive **Saudi Arabian citizenship** in **2017**.
 
• The introduction of **AI teachers** aims to address teacher shortages and provide **24/7** assistance to students, though they are intended to assist rather than replace human educators.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kerala** has consistently been a leader in **literacy** and educational innovation in **India**, being one of the first states to digitize classrooms.
 
• The use of **Generative AI** in schools helps in **Personalized Learning**, allowing the robot to adapt its teaching style according to the student's pace and level of understanding.
 
• The deployment of **Iris** is seen as a step toward achieving the goals of the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes the integration of **technology** in education to improve learning outcomes.

questions.question: Which of the following cities served as the venue for the Curtain Raiser of the 18th Urban Mobility India (UMI) Conference and Exhibition 2025, organised by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurugram, Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Curtain Raiser** of the **18th Urban Mobility India (UMI) Conference and Exhibition 2025** was recently organized by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)**.
 
• The venue for this high-profile preliminary event was **Gurugram, Haryana**, held on **December 13, 2024**.
 
• The event was presided over by the Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs and Power, **Shri Manohar Lal**, who emphasized the need for a robust and sustainable urban transport framework in **India**.
 
• The primary objective of the **Curtain Raiser** was to set the stage for the main **18th UMI conference**, which serves as a platform for state governments, city authorities, and transport experts to exchange ideas and best practices.
 
• The **Urban Mobility India** initiative is part of the government's efforts to implement the **National Urban Transport Policy (NUTP)** and address the challenges of rapid urbanization and traffic congestion.
 
• During the event, the **dates** and **venue** for the main conference in **2025** were discussed, aiming to bring together global leaders in the urban transport sector. ***Hence, the correct answer is Gurugram, Haryana.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Urban Mobility India (UMI) Conference:**
 
 
• It is an annual flagship event organized by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**.
 
• The conference originated from the **National Urban Transport Policy (NUTP)** formulated in **2006**, which focuses on "moving people rather than vehicles."
 
• It provides a forum for **urban transport professionals**, **city planners**, and **industry stakeholders** to interact and learn about the latest **technological advancements** and **policy reforms**.
 
 
 
• **17th UMI Conference (2024):**
 
 
• The **17th edition** of the conference was held in **Gandhinagar, Gujarat**, in **October 2024**.
 
• The theme for the **17th UMI** was **"Standardization and Optimization of Urban Transport Solutions."**
 
• It featured an exhibition showcasing **Electric Vehicles (EVs)**, **Metro Rail** innovations, and **Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS)**.
 
 
 
• **MoHUA Roles and Initiatives:**
 
 
• The **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs** is the nodal ministry for planning and coordination of **urban transport** across **India**.
 
• Key programs supported by the ministry include the **Smart Cities Mission**, **Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT)**, and various **Metro Rail** projects.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sustainability Goals:** The **18th UMI 2025** is expected to focus heavily on **Net Zero** targets and reducing the **carbon footprint** of Indian cities through **Non-Motorized Transport (NMT)** and **green mobility**.
 
• **PM-eBus Sewa:** Discussions at such conferences often revolve around the **PM-eBus Sewa** scheme, which aims to deploy **10,000 electric buses** in **169 cities** to improve urban air quality.
 
• **Metro Network Growth:** **India** currently has the **third-largest metro rail network** in the world, with over **900 kilometers** of operational lines, a topic of central interest at the **UMI 2025** curtain raiser.
 
• **Location Advantage:** **Gurugram** was chosen for the curtain raiser due to its status as a leading **corporate hub** and its experience with diverse urban mobility solutions like **Rapid Metro** and **e-mobility** clusters.
</ul

questions.question: Who was IPL 2025’s Most Valuable Player from Mumbai Indians?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Suryakumar Yadav**__.

__
 
• **Suryakumar Yadav**, often referred to as **"Mr. 360"** for his ability to hit shots in all directions, is a cornerstone of the **Mumbai Indians (MI)** franchise.
 
• In the lead-up to the **IPL 2025** season, **Suryakumar Yadav** was retained as one of the top players by **Mumbai Indians**, reflecting his immense value to the squad's batting department.
 
• His role as a middle-order aggressor is critical, especially given his status as the **ICC No. 1 T20I Batter** for extended periods, showcasing his consistency and dominance in the shortest format of the game.
 
• For the **IPL 2025** retention cycle, he was retained for a significant sum of **INR 16.35 crore**, underscoring his position as a **Most Valuable Player** within the team structure.
 
• His appointment as the permanent **Captain of the Indian T20I team** in **2024** further elevated his stature, making him a primary leadership figure alongside **Hardik Pandya** and **Jasprit Bumrah** for the **Mumbai Indians**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Rohit Sharma**, the legendary former captain who led MI to **five IPL titles**, was retained for **INR 16.30 crore**.
 
• **Tilak Varma** was the fifth retention, secured for **INR 8 crore**.
 
 
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah:**
 
 
• Widely considered the best all-format bowler in the world, **Bumrah** remains the spearhead of the **Mumbai Indians** bowling attack. His ability to bowl at the **death** with **yorkers** and variations makes him indispensable.
 
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma:**
 
 
• The **"Hitman"** has been synonymous with MI's success since **2013**. Under his leadership, the team won championships in **2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, and 2020**.
 
 
 
• **Hardik Pandya:**

questions.question: In 2025, IDFC FIRST Bank has enabled Unified Payments Interface (UPI) access for Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) in how many countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IDFC FIRST Bank** has reached a significant milestone in **January 2025** by enabling **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)** access for **Non-Resident Indians (NRIs)** residing in **12 countries**.
 
• This initiative allows NRIs to use their **international mobile numbers** linked to their **NRE (Non-Resident External)** or **NRO (Non-Resident Ordinary)** accounts to perform **UPI transactions** seamlessly.
 
• The **12 countries** included in this rollout are **Singapore, Australia, Canada, Hong Kong, Oman, Qatar, USA, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates (UAE), United Kingdom (UK), Malaysia, and France**.
 
• The service eliminates the previous requirement for NRIs to have an **Indian mobile number** to access the **UPI ecosystem**, thereby enhancing the ease of doing business and personal transactions for the Indian diaspora.
 
• This development follows the guidelines issued by the **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**, which permitted the use of **international mobile numbers** from specific countries for **UPI onboarding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IDFC FIRST Bank:**
 
 
• It was formed by the merger of the erstwhile **IDFC Bank** and **Capital First**, a leading consumer and MSME financing institution, in **December 2018**.
 
• The bank is headquartered in **Mumbai** and provides a wide range of financial solutions including **savings accounts, NRI services, and corporate banking**.
 
 
 
• **Understanding NRE and NRO Accounts:**
 
 
• **NRE (Non-Resident External) Account:** These accounts are used to park **foreign earnings** in India. The principal and interest are **tax-free** and fully **repatriable** (can be moved back to the foreign country).
 
• **NRO (Non-Resident Ordinary) Account:** These accounts are primarily for managing **income earned in India**, such as rent, dividends, or pension. The interest earned is **taxable** in India.
 
 
 
• **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI):**
 
 
• Established in **2008**, **NPCI** is an initiative of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** and the **Indian Banks' Association (IBA)**.
 
• It manages **UPI, RuPay, IMPS, and Bharat BillPay**, driving the digital payment revolution in India.
 
• **NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL)** is a subsidiary focused on exporting **UPI** and **RuPay** technology to **international markets**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of UPI for NRIs:**
 
 
• NRIs can now pay **merchants** directly via **QR codes** during their visits to India or for services provided in India.
 
• It reduces dependency on **international credit/debit cards** which often carry high **currency conversion fees** and transaction charges.
 
• This move strengthens **India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)** and promotes the global acceptance of the **UPI platform**.
 
 
</ul

questions.question: ‘Montha,’ which made landfall in India in October 2025, was what type of natural phenomenon?

options.text: An extremely severe cyclonic storm over the Kutch region
A tropical thunderstorm affecting coastal Gujarat
A severe cyclonic storm over the Bay of Bengal
A deep depression over the Arabian Sea bringing rainfall to southern India

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A severe cyclonic storm over the Bay of Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **‘Montha’** was a tropical cyclone that developed in the **Bay of Bengal** and made **landfall** on the eastern coast of **India** in **October 2025**.
 
• It was categorized as a **Severe Cyclonic Storm** by the **India Meteorological Department (IMD)**, indicating sustained wind speeds ranging between **89 km/h and 117 km/h**. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
 
• The storm originated from a **low-pressure area** that intensified into a **depression** and subsequently a **deep depression** before reaching the status of a **Severe Cyclonic Storm**.
 
• The timing of the storm, **October**, coincides with the peak **post-monsoon cyclone season** in India, during which the **Bay of Bengal** experiences high thermal energy and favorable atmospheric conditions for cyclogenesis.
 
• Unlike storms over the **Kutch region** or the **Arabian Sea**, **Montha** specifically tracked towards the **Odisha** and **Andhra Pradesh** coastline, bringing heavy precipitation and **storm surges** to the eastern seaboard. ***Hence, statements 1, 2, and 4 are incorrect.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cyclone Classification in India:**
 
 
• The **IMD** classifies tropical disturbances based on **Maximum Sustained Surface Wind Speed (MSW)**.
 
• **Cyclonic Storm**: **62–88 km/h**.
 
• **Severe Cyclonic Storm**: **89–117 km/h**.
 
• **Very Severe Cyclonic Storm**: **118–165 km/h**.
 
• **Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm**: **166–221 km/h**.
 
• **Super Cyclone**: **Above 222 km/h**.
 
 
 
• **Naming of Cyclones:**
 
 
• The name **‘Montha’** is part of the list maintained by the **WMO/ESCAP** (World Meteorological Organization/United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific) Panel on Tropical Cyclones.
 
• Names are contributed by **13 member countries**, including **India**, **Thailand**, **Myanmar**, and **Bangladesh**, to help in unique identification and disaster management.
 
 
 
• **Bay of Bengal vs. Arabian Sea:**
 
 
• Statistically, the **Bay of Bengal** sees a higher frequency of cyclones (ratio of **4:1**) compared to the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• This is due to higher **Sea Surface Temperatures (SST)**, the shape of the coastline, and the influx of remnant depressions from the **South China Sea**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Impact and Mitigation:**
 
 
• Cyclones like **Montha** necessitate the deployment of the **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)** and the activation of **early warning systems**.
 
• The **Color-coded Weather Warning** system (Yellow, Orange, Red) is used by the **IMD** to alert residents and administrative bodies about the severity of the incoming threat.
 
• **Storm Surges**: One of the most dangerous features of a **severe cyclonic storm** is the **storm surge**, which can cause **coastal inundation** up to several kilometers inland, destroying **mangroves** and **infrastructure**.

questions.question: Which of the following insurance companies were designated as Domestic Systemically Important Insurers (D-SIIs) for the year 2024–25 by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)?

options.text: LIC, HDFC ERGO, and Reliance General
LIC, Tata AIG, and Bajaj Allianz
HDFC Life, ICICI Lombard, and SBI Life
LIC, The New India Assurance, and GIC Re

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**LIC, The New India Assurance, and GIC Re**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** has identified and designated three major insurance companies as **Domestic Systemically Important Insurers (D-SIIs)** for the financial year **2024–25**.
 
• The three identified entities are the **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)**, **General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re)**, and **The New India Assurance Co. Ltd**.
 
• These insurers are perceived as being **"too big to fail"** (TBTF) due to their immense size, significant market presence, and deep interconnectedness within the Indian financial system.
 
• The failure of any of these designated insurers could lead to significant **disruptions in the essential services** they provide to the national economy and potentially trigger systemic instability in the broader financial market.
 
• As **D-SIIs**, these companies are subject to **enhanced regulatory oversight** by **IRDAI** to ensure they maintain robust financial health and risk management practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Definition of D-SIIs**:
 
 
• **D-SIIs** refer to insurers whose distress or failure would cause significant dislocation in the domestic financial system.
 
• The assessment for **D-SII** status is conducted **annually** by the **IRDAI** based on various parameters including **size**, **interconnectedness**, **substitutability**, and **complexity**.
 
 
 
• **The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)**:
 
 
• It is a **statutory body** formed under the **IRDA Act, 1999**, functioning under the jurisdiction of the **Ministry of Finance**, **Government of India**.
 
• The headquarters of **IRDAI** is located in **Hyderabad**, having moved from **New Delhi** in **2001**.
 
• The primary objective of **IRDAI** is to protect the interests of policyholders and regulate, promote, and ensure the orderly growth of the insurance industry.
 
 
 
• **Regulatory Requirements for D-SIIs**:
 
 
• Designated insurers are required to raise the levels of **corporate governance** and identify all relevant risks at a granular level.
 
• They must carry out **systemic risk assessments** and maintain additional capital to cushion against potential financial shocks.
 
• Specifically, **LIC**, **GIC Re**, and **New India Assurance** have been part of this list consistently since **September 2020**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)**: Established in **1956**, it is the largest life insurer in the country and a major institutional investor.
 
• **General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re)**: It is the **sole national reinsurer** in the domestic market, providing reinsurance support to direct general insurance companies in **India**.
 
• **The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.**: It is a **multinational general insurance company** and remains the largest public sector general insurance company in **India** based on gross premium collection.
 
• The continuous designation of these three public sector units highlights the **concentration of systemic importance** within government-backed entities in the Indian insurance landscape.
